en.title: Dominica Citizenship by Investment
en.overview: Dominica, known as the beautiful Nature Isle of the Caribbean, offers one of the most reliable and efficient second passport programs in the world. With quick processing speeds and a secure legal foundation, this program grants high-net-worth investors and their families instant global mobility. Our Business Bay firm guides your family securely from start to finish.

specs.title: INVESTMENT TYPE
specs.desc: Choose from economic donation or approved real estate

specs.title: INVESTMENT COST
specs.desc: USD 200,000 for single or USD 250,000 for family of 4

specs.title: FAMILY DEPENDENTS
specs.desc: Includes spouse, dependent children under 30, and dependent parents or grandparents above 65 years old

benefits.title: Global Access
benefits.desc: Visa-free access to over 132 countries including the EU and UK.

benefits.title: Investment Flexibility
benefits.desc: Invest only after application approval, with options including donations or real estate.

benefits.title: Advantageous Tax Conditions
benefits.desc: Enjoy no taxation on worldwide income, gifts, wealth, or inheritance.

benefits.title: Inclusive Family Benefits
benefits.desc: Include dependent children under 30, unmarried daughters under 30, and dependent parents over 55.

benefits.title: Dual Citizenship
benefits.desc: Permitted without the need to renounce your current nationality.

benefits.title: Extended UK Stays
benefits.desc: Stay in the UK for up to 6 months at a time.

benefits.title: Flexible Residency Requirements
benefits.desc: Acquire citizenship without mandatory residency in Dominica.

investment_options.title: 1. Economic Diversification Fund (EDF)
investment_options.desc: Sovereign non-refundable contribution starting from $200,000 USD for a single applicant.

investment_options.title: 2. Approved Real Estate Investment
investment_options.desc: Purchase government-approved luxury resort or eco-villa shares starting from $200,000 USD.
